name: strata-v100-kv-dtypes-262k
description: KV dtype comparison at the 262k window on the resident 4x V100-32G IQ3_S server: int8 baseline vs q4_0 vs k8v4, C1 128-token answers.

estimate.basis: three variant launches (about 5 min each) plus 3 x 72 s prefill per variant

caveats: NEW DEFINITION, first run 2026-10-27. The engine may refuse a dtype at 262k; the sweep records the real launch error.
q4_0 and k8v4 trade precision for KV size; this measures speed only, not quality.
`basefull` is the int8 baseline at the same window and is the control for the two dtypes.
